question: In the case of Vikas KishanRao Gawali vs _________, in January 2021, the Supreme Court observed that OBC reservation cannot exceed 50%.
solution:
The correct answer is __**State of Maharashtra.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The case o**f Vikas Kishan Rao Gawali v. the State of Maharashtra **came before the Supreme Court of India.
 
• The judgment for this case was given by three justices namely A.M.** Khanwilkar, Indu Malhotra, and Ajay Rastogi. The date of the judgment is 04/03/2021. **
 
• **Court: Supreme Court of India**
 
• **Date of judgment: **04/03/2021
 
• **Judges:-**
 
 
• A.M. Khanwilkar
 
• Indu Malhotra
 
• Ajay Rastogi
 
 
 
• The Maharashtra Zilla Parishads and Panchayat Samitis** Act of 1961** and the Constitution of India play an important role in this case.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eknath Shinde** becomes sworn in as Maharashtra CM; **Devendra Fadnavis** is Dy CM.
 
• The 2019 Maharashtra Legislative meeting election became held on **21 October 2019** to select all 288 members of the nation's Legislative assembly.
 
• During the first country assembly election in India, in **1952, Dr. Burgula Ramakrishna Rao **became elected chief minister of Hyderabad kingdom.
